title: Skill Repo Manager
description: Use when working with the davis-llm-skill repository itself: adding skills, syncing across Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot, preparing multi-client adapters, reviewing drift, or resolving conflicts between the repo copy and deployed copies.
claude_description: This skill should be used when the user asks to manage skills, sync skills across platforms, add a skill to the repository, resolve skill conflicts, or maintain the davis-llm-skill repository. Use for any skill repo management task.
copilot_cli_intro: Maintain the shared skill repository: sync skills across Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot. Manage adapters and resolve conflicts.
copilot_rules: Treat the repo as canonical source of truth.
Do not overwrite deployed skills unless differences are reviewed.
Regenerate adapters after shared source changes.
Use sync scripts, never manually copy to deployed directories.
Port local edits back to the repo before syncing outward.
copilot_avoid: Manually copying files instead of using sync scripts
vscode_intro: Manage the davis-llm-skill repository: sync across platforms, update adapters, and resolve conflicts.
vscode_rules: Use the repo as canonical source.
Sync with scripts, not manual file copies.
Review diffs before overwriting deployed skills.
Regenerate adapters after shared source updates.
instruction_rules: Use the skill-repo-manager workflow for repository maintenance.
Treat the repo as canonical source.
Sync outward with provided scripts, never manually.
Import new skills from platforms with import scripts.
Regenerate adapters after any shared source change.
prompt_intro: Manage the davis-llm-skill repository. Sync skills across Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot. Import new skills and resolve conflicts.
prompt_checklist: Identify the task type (authoring, sync, import, conflict).
Check for drift between repo and deployed copies.
Regenerate adapters if shared sources changed.
